test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 04 May 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Improve the underlined part of the sentence. Choose 'No improvement' as an answer if the sentence is grammatically correct.**

He had to brake suddenly to __avoiding hitting__ the deer.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 4'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The underlined part **"to avoiding hitting" **is incorrect because of the improper verb form used with "to."
 
• The correct form should be** "to avoid hitting,**" using the base form of the verb after **"to."**
 
• **"Avoid" **means to prevent something from happening or to keep away from something.

Therefore, the **corrected sentence** is:** "***He had to brake suddenly to avoid hitting the deer." *

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2:** "avoided hitting" doesn't align with the proper verb form needed in this context.
 
• **Option 3: **"avoids hitting" also doesn't follow the correct verb tense.
